description: Volatility-conditional exit-check cadence (hi-vol->15min interval, lo-vol->every-bar continuous) as a fixed-1-contract prop-account vol lever.

regime.proxy: intraday-to-date range cummax(high)-cummin(low) from session open to bar
regime.baseline: trailing-14-session median of run_range at the same mfo, strictly prior (shift 1)

kill_test: REJECT unless dollar-Sharpe uplift > 0, treatment net$ >= baseline net$, and upper-tail p <= 0.05 vs Null C
data_scope: NQ primary + ES sibling, clean Databento RTH through 2026, common post-lookback-90 date set (consumed)
